1. Create folder "todo" and index.html, style.css, app.js.

2. Write index.html: include meta viewport, lang, title, link to style.css, script src=app.js defer. Use header with h1 "Todo List". Use main with section for form and list. Use form with label for input, input type=text, placeholder "Add a new task", button type=submit "Add". Use ul for tasks. Use footer maybe with copyright.

3. Write style.css: define CSS variables: --primary, --secondary, --background, --text, --accent. Use Google Font: e.g., "Inter" from Google Fonts. Use body with font-family, background, color. Use container with max-width, margin auto, padding. Use header styling. Use form styling: flex, gap, input flex:1, button. Use ul styling: list-style:none, padding:0. Use li styling: display:flex, align-items:center, justify-content:space-between, padding, border-bottom. Use .task-text: flex:1, margin-left. Use .done class: text-decoration: line-through, color: var(--text-muted). Use .delete-btn: background:none, border:none, color: var(--accent), cursor:pointer. Use hover effects.

4. Write app.js: On DOMContentLoaded, load tasks from localStorage, render. Add event listeners: form submit to add task, click on checkbox to toggle done, click on delete button to delete. Use localStorage key "todoTasks". Use functions: loadTasks, saveTasks, renderTasks, addTask, toggleTask, deleteTask. Use unique id: Date.now().

5. Ensure accessibility: input has id, label for. Delete button has aria-label. Checkbox has aria-label. Use button type=button for delete.

6. Ensure no console errors: no missing elements.

7. Use view_page to check.
